name: Sundown City
about: An open-world action game in a city made in code: six missions against the Vipers gang, cars, vans and motorbikes to drive, six weapons with a sniper scope, rockets and grenades, police that respond to your heat, day and night. Mouse and keys or a gamepad.
notes: An example game that comes with KimiLM, made with kimi/game 0.3.0 (github.com/kiplabat/kimi-game)
prompt: A 3D open-world third-person action game: a city with roads, towers and buildings you can walk into; cars, minibuses and motorbikes to drive; a pistol, rifle, shotgun, scoped sniper, rocket launcher and grenades; enemies that take cover and flank; police that come when you are wanted; missions; day and night.
